description: Fairy Music v1.0.11: Official Website Integration, In-App Portal Access & Enhanced Performance.

changelog.title: Official Website & In-App Portal Integration
items: Added official website link (fairymusic.vercel.app) to Settings, About Screen, and Welcome dialog
Direct one-tap in-app access to web release portal, real-time changelogs, and community updates
Performance optimizations and playback stability improvements
Seamless in-place upgrade compatible with all previous versions with zero data loss

announcement.title: Fairy Music v1.0.11 & Official Website Live! 🌟
announcement.message: Fairy Music v1.0.11 is now live with official website portal integration! Visit fairymusic.vercel.app or update directly.
